owner_authorization: Owner standing authorization is limited to this B8.1 E0/no-data remediation; it authorizes no data access, activation, execution, report, or research decision.

universes.common_dates: Each primary pair uses exactly U8-common eligible weekly decision dates; no pairwise, complete-case, or post-result selection.

sizing.primary: Apply inherited L1 normalization, target-volatility scale-down-only, caps, cash, weekly timing, trade threshold, locked costs, and accounting identically to U4 and U8.
sizing.inverse_volatility_sensitivity: One frozen q/volatility sensitivity is non-claim-eligible and cannot select a conclusion; L-3 remains unresolved.

component_risk.covariance: Inherited L1 60-session EWMA covariance with deterministic PSD clipping.
component_risk.formula: rc_i = w_i * (Sigma w)_i; p_i = abs(rc_i) / sum_j abs(rc_j); HHI = sum_i p_i^2.
component_risk.cash: Cash is excluded from asset component-risk HHI and reported separately.
component_risk.missingness: A zero or nonfinite component-risk denominator, missing/nonfinite required input, or failed covariance makes the entire paired week non-evaluable and scope_restricted.

realized_hhi_delta.formula: With fixed execution-close weights only, compute sample covariance from exact actual total-return rows t+1 through t+20, deterministically PSD-clip, then apply the component-risk formula; never feed realized covariance into sizing.
realized_hhi_delta.missingness: Any missing or nonfinite input makes the entire paired week non-evaluable.

top_dependency_delta.formula: For each universe market_share=max_i p_i; macro_sleeve_share=sum p_i for its fixed sleeve; top_dependency=max(market_share, macro_sleeve_share); delta=U4-U8.
top_dependency_delta.ties: Report all ties; use inherited ETF order only if one deterministic selection is required.

n_eff_delta.formula: For each eligible t and universe, use continuous signed q series on exactly the trailing 52 common eligible weekly decision dates ending at t, with no future values. Every asset must be complete and nonconstant. Compute Pearson asset-correlation matrix, deterministically clip negative eigenvalues to zero, report clipped mass, and N_eff=(sum lambda)^2/sum(lambda^2); delta=U8-U4.
n_eff_delta.diagnostic: Report mean absolute off-diagonal q correlation only; never count pairs as observations.
n_eff_delta.missingness: Missing, constant, nonfinite, or zero-denominator inputs make the paired week non-evaluable.

best_market.selection: Select the U8 market with greatest cumulative net PnL contribution after exact asset-attributed locked costs over matched dates; ties use inherited ETF order.
best_market.recalculation: Remove that asset from U8 and U4 if present; renormalize remaining component-risk shares without rerunning or reselecting the strategy; recompute mean HHI delta on the same weeks.
best_market.failure: Zero denominator or nonpositive original mean is non-evaluable and fail-closed.

best_trend_episode.episode_rule: Inherited L1 per-asset episode: consecutive weekly nonzero q of one sign, at most one neutral bridge, ending on opposite sign or two neutrals.
best_trend_episode.selection: Select the U8 asset-episode with greatest cumulative net PnL contribution after costs; ties use inherited asset order then earliest start.
best_trend_episode.recalculation: Remove every paired week in that episode from both U4/U8; recompute mean primary HHI delta on remaining common weeks without alternative episode search.
best_trend_episode.minimum_sample: Remaining observations must meet the actual primary HHI MinTRL.

side_effects.turnover_intensity: sum one-way turnover / sum pre-trade gross exposure on identical paired dates
side_effects.cost_intensity: sum all booked locked costs / sum pre-trade gross exposure on identical paired dates
side_effects.relative_increase: (U8-U4)/U4; comparator zero or nonfinite is non-evaluable.
side_effects.cap_cash_scale_down: Use inherited L3 cap/cash/scale-down indicator and frequency on identical paired dates; delta=U8-U4.

statistics.actual_recalculation: For every mandatory weekly paired series separately, recompute lags 1-5, autocorrelation inflation, HAC/Newey-West interval, falsify MinTRL, and validation MinTRL. No series may fund another.

equity_synchronization: all four equity q signs same nonzero
regime_matrix.no_pooling: Every inferential bucket independently meets its own actual metric MinTRL; underfunded buckets are descriptive and block the corresponding E2 scope claim.

timing_and_decisions.scope_restricted: Any mandatory input/gate non-evaluable, required sample below actual MinTRL, or required E2 regime coverage underfunded; never silently pass or falsify.
timing_and_decisions.falsified_E1_only: At least one funded mandatory series has one-sided 95% UCB strictly below its useful threshold, or an evaluable funded side-effect or robustness rule breaches; mechanism autopsy is required and validation remains sealed.
timing_and_decisions.not_falsified_not_validated_E1: Falsification sample is funded and evaluable, no falsification trigger occurs, and validation remains sealed.
timing_and_decisions.validation_candidate_future_only: Only a future separately authorized untouched stage: every mandatory one-sided 95% LCB strictly exceeds its useful threshold, robustness and side effects pass, required regimes are separately funded, and costs/search/data-integrity/adversarial review pass. B8.1 grants no E2.
timing_and_decisions.equality: UCB equal to a useful threshold is not falsification; LCB equal to a useful threshold is not validation-candidate; outcomes are mutually exclusive.

static_capacity.observation_unit: one weekly paired portfolio observation; never assets, days, trades, windows, sleeves, or correlations.

hard_stops: No data/container/path discovery or inspection beyond named methodology sources and committed controls.
No market, return, signal, position, covariance, regime, cost, or PnL computation or backtest.
No validation, provider/network, credentials, broker, paid, paper-trade, or real-money action.
No L-4 activation, execution runner, report, ledger, or B8.2.
No L-3 closure weakening or inverse-volatility pass claim.
